sam_k: FYI onboarding new model 'falcon-x-7b-quant' — CI lint failed on config.json, need a quick eyeball. s3 path: s3://redwood-models/falcon-x/7b/weights/sha256-9a8b7c
anita: pinging in. what lint errors are we seeing? :eyes:
sam_k: CI prints: "ERROR Validator: missing required field 'model.family'" and later "WARN tokenizer.vocab_size mismatch (expected 50257, got null)". full log: https://ci.redwood/builds/2345/log
lee: I can take a look. did the model pack include tokenizer.json? sometimes quant pipelines strip vocab_size
ben_m: also saw "Unexpected field: optimization.quant.type" — our schema now forbids nested 'optimization' key, should be top-level 'optimizations' array
sam_k: here's the snippet from their config they uploaded:
```
{
  "model": {
    "name": "falcon-x-7b-quant"
  },
  "weights": {
    "location": "s3://redwood-models/falcon-x/7b/weights/sha256-9a8b7c",
    "format": "safetensors"
  },
  "tokenizer": {
    "cls_token": "<s>",
    "sep_token": "</s>"
    // missing vocab_size, pad_token
  },
  "optimization": {
    "quant": { "type": "awq", "bits": 4 }
  }
}
```
anita: OK a few things:
- must include `model.family` (e.g., "falcon-x") for routing and kernel selection
- tokenizer must explicitly include `vocab_size` and `pad_token` or we fallback to infer which breaks on some tokenizers
- `optimization` should be renamed to `optimizations` as a list of objects per new schema
lee: I can patch a validator rule to accept the old `optimization` key with a migration warning. quick PR? @ben_m if you agree I'll add a one-off transform in onboarding pipeline
ben_m: agree, add transform + warn. but we should reject if `tokenizer.vocab_size` missing for hosted deployments; private might allow inference fallback
ml-ci-bot: Build #2345: lint FAILED — missing fields: model.family, tokenizer.vocab_size. See https://ci.redwood/builds/2345
sam_k: action items: (1) lee adds migration for `optimization` -> `optimizations` (2) sam will upload an amended config with model.family and tokenizer.vocab_size (3) anita will add a short note to model onboarding checklist about pad_token and vocab_size required for quantized weights
anita: can you also add the s3 sha to metadata in the model registry? we rely on exact checksum for fallback routing
sam_k: yes adding now. PR 6789: https://git.redwood/pulls/6789 — small patch to config + tests
lee: quick lint locally: `python tools/config_lint.py --file model-config.json` shows warnings fixed. pushing migration in 10m :shipit:
ben_m: when migration lands, can we run the validator against the rest of the queued uploads? might be other older packs
sam_k: good call. I'll queue a bulk lint job after PR merges
anita: thanks all. if CI passes after these small changes we can onboard tonight. :white_check_mark:
sam_k: thanks :heart:
ml-ci-bot: Build #2350: lint PASSED for PR 6789
